mission: Account for every canonical fleet bot, category, division, and specialist agent; detect duplicates, missing metadata, category drift, placement mismatches, and unowned specialist capabilities without changing the fixed fleet blindly.

canonical_fleet.source: App_bots/*.json where growth is not true

placement_rules: Growth profiles remain separately counted supplemental sources. They must meet the same identity, metadata, and declared-total checks, and every expected growth division must remain present.
Every canonical bot appears in exactly one App_bots division file.
Every canonical bot has one primary division and may use collaborator divisions instead of duplicate profiles.
Every bot category is inventoried and category counts are reported.
Declared total in each division file must equal the actual bot array length.
Missing slug/category/capabilities/status metadata is a release blocker.
High-confidence placement move candidates are reviewed, not auto-moved.
Specialist GitHub agents are accounted separately from the fixed 1,051 profile fleet until formally onboarded through the fleet runtime/catalog generator.
New specialist agents must declare a primary DreamCo owner division.
truth_rule: Accounting completeness and placement scoring are separate. Canonical profiles, supplemental growth profiles, and specialist agent definitions are counted separately; none is proof of operational capability. Placement changes require canonical-owner review and regression tests.
